Heavyset Build.description:
💪 Build: Heavyset Build
Noticeably large and carrying significant weight — wide frame with thick limbs and a heavy torso. A substantial physical presence.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Heavyset Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Heavyset frame — thick torso, full midsection, heavy limbs. The body carries substantial mass distributed broadly, sitting heavy and grounded in the frame. Female: shoulders soft above a full waist, short thick neck, round jaw and full chin, the chest line above a full waist. Male: shoulders heavy, neck thick, jaw broad, a flat chest over a full midsection. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure carrying broad mass.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
